# Cogpite

> Cogpite is an AI-powered procurement intelligence platform that helps East African ICT firms discover, track, and win government tenders. It scrapes 15+ official procurement portals across Uganda (PPDA), Kenya (PPRA), Rwanda (RPPA), and Tanzania (PPRA) and delivers AI-matched RFPs to subscribers.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2024
- Headquarters: Kampala, Uganda
- Coverage: Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania
- Portals Scraped: 15+ government procurement portals
- Update Frequency: Multiple times daily
- Free Tier: Available (Local Scout plan)

## What Cogpite Does
Cogpite automates the entire government tender discovery process for ICT companies in East Africa. Instead of manually checking PPDA, PPRA, RPPA, and dozens of district-level procurement websites, Cogpite's AI engine:
1. Scrapes all major procurement portals every few hours
2. Downloads and parses tender documents (PDFs, DOCs, web pages)
3. Extracts scope, budget tier, tech stack requirements, and deadlines
4. Scores each tender against your company's profile for relevance
5. Delivers real-time alerts for high-confidence matches

## Features
- Real-time RFP monitoring from 15+ East African procurement portals
- AI-powered document parsing and tech stack extraction
- Match confidence scoring against company profiles
- Custom alert rules (by keyword, budget, sector, country)
- Deadline tracking and pipeline management
- Team collaboration and bid assignment
- Email and webhook notifications

## Countries & Portals Covered
- **Uganda**: PPDA (Public Procurement and Disposal of Public Assets Authority), district local governments
- **Kenya**: PPRA (Public Procurement Regulatory Authority), county governments
- **Rwanda**: RPPA (Rwanda Public Procurement Authority)
- **Tanzania**: PPRA (Public Procurement Regulatory Authority)
- **International**: DevEx, ReliefWeb (donor-funded ICT projects)

## Pricing Plans
- **Local Scout** (Free): Basic RFP search, 1 country, standard filters
- **Enterprise Hunter** (Paid): All countries, AI extraction, real-time alerts, team seats, webhook integrations
